teaser.en: A giant liana with pods longer than a person is tall; its big, shiny seeds float across oceans and wash up on beaches.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa mkubwa sana wenye maganda marefu kuliko kimo cha mtu; mbegu zake kubwa zinazong'aa huelea kuvuka bahari na kusukumwa ufuoni.

summary.en: Mfwihi is a huge woody liana of the pea family, known for its enormous pods and large floating seeds. The seeds are carried by rivers and the sea and wash up on tropical beaches far away.
summary.sw: Mfwihi ni mtambaa mkubwa sana wenye shina la mti wa jamii ya kunde, unaojulikana kwa maganda yake makubwa mno na mbegu kubwa zinazoelea. Mbegu hizo husafirishwa na mito na bahari na hufika kwenye fuo za tropiki zilizo mbali sana.

about.en: Mfwihi is a giant woody climber whose stems can be thick and twisted like cables, climbing high into the forest canopy. Its leaves are divided twice, and the tip of each leaf is often modified into a tendril. Small, creamy-yellow, fragrant flowers grow in long, slender spikes. The pods are its most famous feature. They are woody, flattened and jointed, and can reach well over a metre in length, with each segment holding one seed. The seeds are large, about 5 cm across, flat, round and shiny dark brown, and they float.
about.sw: Mfwihi ni mtambaa mkubwa sana wenye shina la mti, ambao mashina yake yanaweza kuwa manene na kusokotana kama kamba kubwa, ukipanda juu hadi kwenye dari la msitu. Majani yake yamegawanyika mara mbili, na ncha ya kila jani mara nyingi hubadilika ikawa kikonyo. Maua madogo ya rangi ya krimu-manjano yenye harufu nzuri huota katika visuke virefu vyembamba. Maganda ndiyo sifa yake maarufu zaidi. Ni magumu kama mti, bapa na yenye viungo, na yanaweza kufikia urefu wa zaidi ya mita moja, kila kipande kikiwa na mbegu moja. Mbegu ni kubwa, karibu sm 5 kwa upana, bapa, za mviringo na za rangi ya hudhurungi iliyokolea inayong'aa, na huelea.

where.en: It grows in riverine and coastal forest, often near streams and estuaries. Its seeds drift down rivers to the sea, and the species is found on tropical coasts of Africa, Asia and Australia.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya pwani, mara nyingi karibu na vijito na hori. Mbegu zake huchukuliwa na mito hadi baharini, na spishi hii hupatikana katika pwani za tropiki za Afrika, Asia na Australia.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. Across its range the hard seeds are hollowed out as snuff boxes, carried as charms and used in traditional medicine. The raw seeds are toxic.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Katika maeneo yote unakopatikana, mbegu ngumu hutobolewa ndani zikawa vibweta vya tumbaku ya kunusa, hubebwa kama hirizi na hutumika katika tiba za jadi. Mbegu mbichi zina sumu.

names.en: Digo: *mfwihi*. Pakia records it in his list only, with no meaning and no English or Swahili name. In English the seeds are known as sea beans, or snuff-box sea beans.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfwihi*. Pakia analirekodi katika orodha yake tu, bila maana na bila jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza mbegu zake hujulikana kama *sea beans*, au *snuff-box sea beans*.
